public_rationale: The forecast remains before its deadline. Low reported vacancy and rising financing stress point to different aspects of the market, and neither establishes whether most loans have collateral worth less than their principal. No event meets the early-resolution rule. The loan universe, weighting and valuation basis also need to be fixed before a financial verdict.
limitations: North American vacancy data do not cover the entire forecast universe.
Debt-market stress is not equivalent to undercollateralization.
The accounting or valuation basis remains unspecified.
The compound demand and loan forecast may ultimately require separate findings.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: There is not enough AI demand for the data centers being built, and most data center loans will be underwater within two years.

statement.excerpt: I also believe they’re going to need bigger hedges, because I don’t think there is enough actual demand for AI to meet the data centers being built, and I think most data center loans end up being underwater within the next two years.

from_speaker: not enough actual demand for AI to meet the data centers being built
underwater within the next two years
our_interpretation: The plain financial reading of underwater is outstanding loan principal exceeding the realizable value of its collateral.
Most means more than half by loan count. Principal-weighted results should also be reported because the speaker supplied no weighting.
The relevant cohort is AI-related data-center loans outstanding or committed at publication, consistent with the surrounding discussion of facilities then being built.
Insufficient demand means delivered capacity cannot attract enough paying use to sustain its economics; announced contracts alone do not measure actual use.
The demand statement is part of the forecast and its proposed explanation, not an antecedent that must occur before the forecast can be assessed.
No accounting or valuation basis is stated. It remains unknown and cannot be silently supplied to produce a supported or contradicted financial verdict.
criteria.support_condition: By December 29, 2027, representative matched loan and collateral records establish that more than half of the defined cohort became underwater, accompanied by evidence of insufficient paying demand for the relevant new capacity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Complete or representative evidence through the deadline establishes that no more than half of the cohort became underwater, or that the forecast demand shortfall did not occur. If the two components diverge, assess them separately rather than treating one as proof of the other.
